name: Nichia high-brightness blue InGaN LED
description: A high-brightness indium-gallium-nitride blue light-emitting diode developed at Nichia.

date.basis: Date or stated historical interval in cited source; see caveats.

contributions.resource: Developed blue LED devices at Nichia.

events.caveats: Nakamura’s biography dates a Tokyo press conference to 29 November; his lecture dates a press statement to 30 November. These may be distinct events, so the general announcement is kept at year precision. This is a blue emitter, not a finished white lighting system.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest sourced event establishing this scoped achievement; it is not a claim of global priority.

caveats: Earlier blue emitters, semiconductor LEDs and critical GaN work by other groups preceded this device. No specific white-lamp adoption is inferred.
